entities.name: PMID:25429984
observations: Japanese retrospective cohort of 52 biopsy-proven NASH patients; median repeat-biopsy interval 968 days.
Failure to achieve a ≥30% ALT decrease predicted NAS deterioration (HR 5.85, P=0.031) and fibrosis progression (HR 4.50, P=0.029). Finding concerns serial ALT response, not baseline ALT alone.

entities.name: ALT response predicts NASH course
observations: In 52 Japanese NASH patients with repeat biopsies, failure of ALT to decrease ≥30% was associated with NAS deterioration (HR 5.85) and fibrosis progression (HR 4.50).
